Where no attachment style is activated
too little at stake to trigger the system — everyone looks secure in this corner
keeps the structure alive past the warmth; presence maintained as proof of the bond

MOTIVATIONAL SIGNATURE — WHAT ACTUALLY KEEPS THE FRIENDSHIP RUNNING
intrinsic — pleasure, chemistry, flow; wanted for itself
mixed — genuinely rewarding and genuinely owed
avoidance — maintained to prevent guilt or loss
extrinsic — real motive, but it sits outside the tie
drive absent — nothing much registers either way
• a context strips out the small talk — travel, crisis, late hours
• one person discloses first and it is not punished
• no privacy; the setting rewards surface only
• a role is attached — boss, client, in-law, patient
• chemistry — the specific pleasure of being read accurately
• disclosure is rewarding in itself, before any payoff
• the depth recurs across unrelated contexts, not one
• a rupture gets repaired instead of quietly dropped
• no low-effort touchpoint once the context ends
• motivation is one-sided; only one person reaches
• being known over time compounds; history rewards itself
• wanting continuity, rather than fearing its absence
• lives diverge and depth stops being replenished
• conflict gets avoided rather than repaired; topics narrow
• almost nothing — this is the default direction
• structure outlives depth, so the loss stays invisible
• it inverts: the pleasure drains, the calendar entry stays
• what was chemistry becomes a standing obligation
• someone breaks the script — real disclosure at the ritual
• a crisis makes the surface arrangement untenable
• the ritual is comfortable; keeping it costs nothing
• years of surface set a strong precedent to defect from
• the old chemistry is often still there, and recoverable
• shared history is the asset the depth rebuilds on
Chemistry moves you up. Continuity moves you right. Neither substitutes for the other.
Chemistry alone gives you the instant-intimacy stranger: deep and undurable. Continuity alone gives
you the duty friend: durable and undeep. Core confidant needs both — which is why it is the one cell
on this map you cannot arrive at by drifting.
Obligation only lives on the committed side.
Every open and half-filled glyph sits right of centre. Commitment is what makes obligation possible;
depth is what makes it bearable. Drain the depth, keep the structure, and you get the bottom-right.
Drift downward is free and needs no decision. Reclaiming upward requires someone to break the script
on purpose. That is why the drift card is the only one with no real hurdle to list.

Aristotle’s lens: bottom-left ≈ utility · middle ≈ pleasure · top-right ≈ virtue. Attachment placements mark where each style is most comfortable, not where it is confined. Illustrative, not diagnostic.
